messages:
Elena: Heads-up — two interview panels ended up at 3pm today (onsite + virtual). Can someone cover scribe or swap? Need quick async covers. Candidate L., final round for Eng Infra.
Owen: I can swap my 4:30 block to 3pm if that helps, but I'm on call until 2:45. Which panel needs scribe vs debrief lead?
Elena: Panel 1 is onsite (Room A) — needs scribe + rubric lead. Panel 2 is virtual and covered. If someone can scribe Panel 1, I can take debrief lead.
Carlos: I can scribe Panel 1. Will I need access to the debrief form and preset? link pls.
recruiter-bot: Reminder — candidate L. consent form pending: https://redwood.hiring/consent/L — please confirm before session.
Maya: Quick rubric Q: for infra finals, do we keep system-design 50% / implementation 30% / culture 20% or did we tweak that after last calibration? Want to avoid inconsistent scoring.
Dena: We discussed 45/35 last week but for final onsite rounds we agreed to keep system-design heavier. My vote: 50/30/20.
Elena: OK keep 50/30/20 for finals today. Carlos please use the debrief link below and select the "final-infra" preset.

```
Debrief form: https://redwood.docs/debriefs/final
Preset: #final-infra
```
Carlos: Got it. I'll scribe and submit within 1 hour after panel. Tagging @Owen — if you swap please confirm calendar invite.
Owen: Swapping now, calendar updated. :thumbsup:
Maya: Small ask — if anyone has a short regression prompt set for infra (smoke tests) paste here, want to add a micro-eval to the debrief.
Elena: Short set in this gist: https://gists.redwood/promptsets/infra-mini — use tests 1-3 only.
recruiter-bot: Calendar invites updated. Candidate L. interview starts 15:00 PT. :calendar: 
Dena: Thanks all. If anything changes ping here, otherwise I'll run a quick calibration at 16:45 for debrief leads.
